name: String Machine
description: Seventies string ensemble: three octaves of sawtooth per key through a tone filter and a three-phase bucket-brigade ensemble chorus.

params.name: Attack
params.description: How long a note takes to fade in. Short starts at once, like an organ; long is a slow string swell.

params.name: Release
params.description: How long a note takes to fade out after the key is released.

params.name: Cello
params.description: Level of the sawtooth an octave below the played note, the deep cello register.

params.name: Violin
params.description: Level of the sawtooth an octave above the played note, the bright violin register.

params.name: Tone
params.description: Low-pass filter shared by all the notes. Lower is darker and mellower; higher is brighter and buzzier.

params.name: Ensemble
params.description: Blend from the dry sawtooths to the three-line chorus that makes them shimmer like a string section. At zero the sound is dry.

params.name: Speed
params.description: How fast the ensemble chorus sweeps, both its slow swell and its quick shimmer. Slower is calmer; faster is more of a wobble.

params.name: Drift
params.description: How far each key wanders slowly out of tune on its own, which keeps held chords from sounding static.

params.name: Width
params.description: Stereo width of the ensemble chorus, down to mono at zero. It does nothing while Ensemble is at zero.

params.name: Volume
params.description: Output level of the instrument. A soft clip after it rounds off the peaks when many notes stack up.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. The architecture follows the ARP Solina/Omni family in outline (octave-related sawtooths per key, one shared filter, a three-line chorus whose LFOs sit 120 degrees apart at about 0.6 Hz and 6 Hz); it is not a circuit model.
